agentsquare-scienceworld.reference_check: Scorer check: with the reproducible JVM setting the simulator's (now deterministic) gold action sequences reach progress 1.0 on 74 of the 90 labels and on 7 of the 10 sampled variations (default runs, where gold routes vary: 70 to 74 of 90; 1.1.3: 71; 1.2.3: 55); the rest are labels that name one of several valid objects or a step the gold route skips. Labels byte-identical to AgentBoard's data.tar.gz member (sha256 ed58212d...).

reproducibility_check.problem: Default JVM: replaying each label's gold action sequence 3 times in one process gave different observations in 21 of 90 labels (33 differences only in line order, 25 in line content: container-content order and temperatures such as 166 vs 167 degrees Celsius).
reproducibility_check.fix: The adapter starts the simulator's JVM with -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:hashCode=2 (via JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS); observation text is not modified and the progress rate is computed as before.
reproducibility_check.result: With the fix: 0 of 90 labels differ across 3 replays in one process; a second process reproduced all 90 gold sequences and all 90 replay traces exactly. Unit test test_scienceworld_replays_are_identical (label 21: 3 distinct traces in 4 replays without the setting, 1 with it).
reproducibility_check.evaluator_runs: suite/agentsquare-scienceworld/evaluator.py on the seed, twice: 0.6802381 and 0.6802381 (identical per-episode results); run.py evaluate agentsquare-scienceworld: 0.6802381; empty candidate: valid false ('candidate must define act()')

agentsquare-webshop.reason: Blocked input: WebShop's product and goal files are distributed only through the Google Drive IDs in setup.sh (WebShop commit 64fa2a5), and all three files of the small setting (items_shuffle_1000, items_ins_v2_1000, items_human_ins) return HTTP 404 on 2026-10-10; AgentSquare's own runs use a remote WebShop server, which the network rule excludes. The remaining copies are AgentBoard's 1.4 GB data archive (the full 1.18-million-product files, not the 1000-product setting, and too large for a small local evaluator) and unofficial third-party mirrors of unverifiable provenance, so the task is not implemented.
evidence: AgentBoard data.tar.gz (huggingface hkust-nlp/agentboard 0680548) lists data/webshop/data/items_shuffle.json and items_ins_v2.json (full setting, each > 50 MB)
